scripts/powershell/active-directory/AD-G.description: Audits AD group memberships with recursive expansion, disabled user filtering, and HTML/CSV report output.
scripts/powershell/active-directory/AD-G.notes: ReportPath defaults to current directory. Use -GroupNames for targeted audits or -GroupNameFilter for wildcard.

scripts/powershell/active-directory/AD-S.description: Finds stale computer accounts inactive for N days and optionally disables or deletes them.
scripts/powershell/active-directory/AD-S.notes: Defaults to 90 days inactivity. Use -WhatIf to preview before making changes.

scripts/powershell/active-directory/Doma.description: Runs AD domain health checks including dcdiag, replication status, FSMO roles, and time sync.
scripts/powershell/active-directory/Doma.notes: Can skip dcdiag or replication checks individually. Targets all DCs by default.

scripts/powershell/active-directory/GPO-.description: Exports and backs up Group Policy Objects to a specified folder with optional XML reports.
scripts/powershell/active-directory/GPO-.notes: BackupPath defaults to a timestamped folder. Use -GpoDisplayNames for targeted exports.

scripts/powershell/active-directory/OU-S.description: Documents Active Directory OU hierarchy with counts of computers, users, groups, and child OUs.
scripts/powershell/active-directory/OU-S.notes: Starts from a specified OU path or the domain root. Outputs HTML and optional CSV.

scripts/powershell/active-directory/Pass.description: Audits AD password policies including fine-grained password policies and user password age.
scripts/powershell/active-directory/Pass.notes: Can audit all users for password age compliance with warning/critical thresholds.

scripts/powershell/active-directory/Priv.description: Monitors privileged AD group memberships with optional baseline comparison for change detection.
scripts/powershell/active-directory/Priv.notes: Use -UpdateBaseline to capture current state, then -CompareWithBaseline on subsequent runs.

scripts/powershell/azure/AzureADConnectH.description: Checks Azure AD Connect sync health, including last sync time, errors, and warning flags.
scripts/powershell/azure/AzureADConnectH.notes: Requires Az.Accounts module. Use -SkipAzConnect if already connected.

scripts/powershell/azure/AzureBackupComp.description: Audits Azure VM backup configuration to identify VMs without proper backup protection.
scripts/powershell/azure/AzureBackupComp.notes: Checks all subscriptions by default. Use -SubscriptionIds to scope down.

scripts/powershell/azure/AzureVMInventor.description: Inventories Azure VMs across subscriptions and estimates monthly running costs by VM size.
scripts/powershell/azure/AzureVMInventor.notes: Cost estimates are based on standard PAYG rates. Outputs HTML report with cost breakdown.

scripts/powershell/azure/AzureVMAutoShut.description: Audits and optionally applies auto-shutdown schedules to Azure VMs to reduce costs.
scripts/powershell/azure/AzureVMAutoShut.notes: Use -ApplySchedules to tag unscheduled VMs with a default shutdown time. Supports -WhatIf.

scripts/powershell/azure/NSGAudit.ps1.description: Audits Azure Network Security Group rules for high-risk configurations like any-to-any or wide-open ports.
scripts/powershell/azure/NSGAudit.ps1.notes: Use -FlagHighRiskOnly to show only risky rules. Includes default rules unless -IncludeDefaultRules is set.

scripts/powershell/azure/RBACAuditScript.description: Audits Azure RBAC role assignments across subscriptions, highlighting privileged roles.
scripts/powershell/azure/RBACAuditScript.notes: Flags Owner, Contributor, and User Access Administrator by default. Customize with -PrivilegedRoles.

scripts/powershell/azure/ResourceTagging.description: Audits and enforces required tags on Azure resources across subscriptions.
scripts/powershell/azure/ResourceTagging.notes: -RequiredTags is mandatory. Use -ApplyTags to add missing tags, -WhatIf to preview.

scripts/powershell/azure/StorageAccountP.description: Scans Azure storage accounts for public network access, anonymous blob access, and firewall misconfigurations.
scripts/powershell/azure/StorageAccountP.notes: Checks all subscriptions by default. Generates HTML report with risk ratings.

scripts/powershell/azure/SubscriptionAud.description: Generates a comprehensive audit report of Azure subscriptions including RBAC, resources, and optional cost data.
scripts/powershell/azure/SubscriptionAud.notes: Set -IncludeSpending to pull cost data (requires additional permissions).

scripts/powershell/exchange/ForwardingRu.description: Detects and optionally removes mailbox forwarding rules and inbox rule forwarding in Exchange Online.
scripts/powershell/exchange/ForwardingRu.notes: Separate switches for mailbox-level forwarding and inbox rule forwarding. -WhatIf to preview removals.

scripts/powershell/exchange/InboxRuleExf.description: Detects suspicious inbox rules that may indicate data exfiltration (forwarding to external domains, deletion rules).
scripts/powershell/exchange/InboxRuleExf.notes: Customize suspicious keywords/domains. Reports all rules or only suspicious ones.

scripts/powershell/exchange/LitigationHo.description: Enables, disables, or reports on litigation hold for Exchange Online mailboxes.
scripts/powershell/exchange/LitigationHo.notes: Use -ReportOnly to audit current hold status without changes. -HoldDurationDays sets retention.

scripts/powershell/exchange/MailboxPermi.description: Audits Exchange Online mailbox permissions including FullAccess, SendAs, and SendOnBehalf.
scripts/powershell/exchange/MailboxPermi.notes: Target specific users with -UserPrincipalNames or audit all mailboxes. Filters by permission type.

scripts/powershell/exchange/MailboxSizeG.description: Reports on Exchange Online mailbox sizes with growth trend analysis over a configurable window.
scripts/powershell/exchange/MailboxSizeG.notes: Use -ShowGrowth to track size changes. -WarningSizeGB and -CriticalSizeGB flag oversized mailboxes.

scripts/powershell/exchange/SharedMailbo.description: Auto-provisions shared mailboxes from a CSV and optionally grants access permissions.
scripts/powershell/exchange/SharedMailbo.notes: CSV must have at minimum a 'Name' column. Can add users as members and grant FullAccess/SendAs.

scripts/powershell/exchange/TransportRul.description: Exports or imports Exchange Online transport rules (mail flow rules) with parameter sets.
scripts/powershell/exchange/TransportRul.notes: Use -ExportPath to export rules to XML, -ImportPath to import from XML. -WhatIf for import preview.

scripts/powershell/m365/BulkUserOffboard.description: Bulk offboards users via CSV or UPN list: revokes sessions, converts to shared mailbox, forwards email, removes licenses.
scripts/powershell/m365/BulkUserOffboard.notes: Two parameter sets: -CsvPath for CSV input or -UserPrincipalNames for manual list. -WhatIf to preview.

scripts/powershell/m365/BulkUserOnboardi.description: Bulk onboards new users from a CSV into Microsoft 365 with mailbox creation and license assignment.
scripts/powershell/m365/BulkUserOnboardi.notes: CSV must include at minimum: FirstName, LastName, UserPrincipalName. -WhatIf to preview.

scripts/powershell/m365/GuestAccountAudi.description: Audits guest accounts in the tenant and optionally removes or blocks sign-in for stale guests.
scripts/powershell/m365/GuestAccountAudi.notes: Stale threshold defaults to 90 days. -RemoveStaleGuests deletes, -BlockSignInForStale blocks.

scripts/powershell/m365/LicenseOptimizat.description: Analyzes M365 license assignments to identify inactive or unlicensed users and optimization opportunities.
scripts/powershell/m365/LicenseOptimizat.notes: Set -InactiveThresholdDays to define inactivity. -ShowUnlicensedUsers to include unlicensed accounts.

scripts/powershell/m365/MFAEnforcementRe.description: Reports on MFA enrollment status across all users, including Conditional Access policy coverage analysis.
scripts/powershell/m365/MFAEnforcementRe.notes: Checks per-user MFA methods and CA policy coverage. Flags non-compliant users. CSV export available.

scripts/powershell/m365/PrivilegedRoleAu.description: Audits Microsoft Entra ID privileged role assignments including permanent and PIM-eligible members.
scripts/powershell/m365/PrivilegedRoleAu.notes: Use -IncludePimEligible and -IncludePermanent to control which assignments are reported.

scripts/powershell/m365/RiskySignInParse.description: Retrieves and parses risky sign-in events from Entra ID with risk level filtering.
scripts/powershell/m365/RiskySignInParse.notes: Defaults to last 24 hours. Supports risk level filtering: low, medium, high, none.

scripts/powershell/m365/SecureScoreRepor.description: Retrieves Microsoft Secure Score with optional control-level breakdown for security posture analysis.
scripts/powershell/m365/SecureScoreRepor.notes: Use -IncludeControlScores for detailed per-control scoring. Generates HTML and CSV output.

scripts/powershell/m365/StaleUserDetecti.description: Detects stale/inactive user accounts in Entra ID and optionally disables them.
scripts/powershell/m365/StaleUserDetecti.notes: Configurable inactivity period. -IncludeNeverLoggedIn catches accounts that never signed in.

scripts/powershell/m365/conditional-acce.description: Audits Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policies. Flattens policies to JSON/CSV, resolves Named Location GUIDs, and flags weak or misconfigured policies.
scripts/powershell/m365/conditional-acce.notes: Outputs a structured CSV with each policy condition expanded. Use -TenantId for cross-tenant audits.

scripts/powershell/security/EmailAuth-Au.description: Audits SPF, DKIM, and DMARC DNS records for a list of domains. Generates HTML report with color-coded status.
scripts/powershell/security/EmailAuth-Au.notes: Reads domains from a predefined CSV path. Interactive export format selection. Requires DnsClient module (built into Windows).

scripts/powershell/server/BackupVerifica.description: Verifies Windows backup status via wbadmin or VSS on one or more servers.
scripts/powershell/server/BackupVerifica.notes: Checks backup age and raises alerts if backups are older than threshold. Email alerts supported.

scripts/powershell/server/DiskSpaceMonit.description: Monitors disk space on local or remote servers with warning/critical thresholds and email alerts.
scripts/powershell/server/DiskSpaceMonit.notes: Defaults to local machine. Targets remote machines via -ComputerNames. Sends email alerts when thresholds breached.

scripts/powershell/server/EventLogAnomal.description: Parses Windows event logs for critical errors and anomalies with burst detection and Event ID filtering.
scripts/powershell/server/EventLogAnomal.notes: Scans System, Application, Security logs. Burst detection flags repeated Event IDs in a time window.

scripts/powershell/server/FileServerPerm.description: Audits NTFS and share permissions on file server paths with recursion depth control.
scripts/powershell/server/FileServerPerm.notes: -Paths is mandatory. Reports inherited and explicit permissions. Can scan remote servers for unused shares.

scripts/powershell/server/HyperV-VMInven.description: Inventories Hyper-V VMs across one or more hosts with optional snapshot, network, and storage details.
scripts/powershell/server/HyperV-VMInven.notes: Targets local host by default. Include snapshots/networks/storage with corresponding switches.

scripts/powershell/server/PatchComplianc.description: Checks Windows patch compliance against Microsoft Update catalog via WU API on one or more servers.
scripts/powershell/server/PatchComplianc.notes: Reports missing updates by KB ID. Can flag servers not patched within N days.

scripts/powershell/server/ServiceHealthM.description: Monitors critical Windows services across remote servers and sends alerts on stopped services.
scripts/powershell/server/ServiceHealthM.notes: Defaults to common critical services. Specify custom services with -ServiceNames. Email alerts supported.

scripts/powershell/server/event-log-anom.description: Windows Event Log Anomaly Parser with burst detection. Detects critical errors, service crashes, and auth failures across local or remote machines.
scripts/powershell/server/event-log-anom.notes: Uses Get-WinEvent with burst detection. Flags repeated Event IDs within a configurable time window. Exports to CSV/JSON.

scripts/powershell/server/monitor-disk-s.description: Unattended disk space monitor designed for Task Scheduler execution. Sends email alerts when free space drops below threshold.
scripts/powershell/server/monitor-disk-s.notes: Configurable via in-script variables. No parameters needed. Designed for scheduled, non-interactive use.
scripts/powershell/server/monitor-disk-s.examples: # Configure variables in the script, then schedule with Task Scheduler: pwsh -File "monitor-disk-space.ps1"
